generate_semantic_images: run the SemanticStableDiffusionPipeline to generate images with semantic guidance using editing prompts and guidance scales
configure_editing_prompts: build a pipeline that uses editing prompts with reverse editing direction to increase or decrease concepts in generated images
set_semantic_guidance_parameters: create a generation call with edit warmup steps, cooldown steps, and momentum scale for fine-grained semantic control
run_safety_checker: run the safety checker on generated images to detect NSFW content using the CLIP feature extractor
prepare_latents_for_generation: build a latent tensor with custom noise scaled by the scheduler for image generation with a specific batch size
